scenarios.note: dropping the row re-arms nothing; a lift with the wrong `at` re-arms nothing; only the exact lift does

scenarios.name: withdrawn-freshness
scenarios.note: the fetch is at most 2 h old AND the document itself at most 26 h old: a replayed, still-unexpired document cannot pass for fresh (OPEN.md O-20)

scenarios.name: unparseable-range-covers-all
scenarios.note: a row whose range the client cannot parse covers EVERY version (common-v1.md §6.3) — in EITHER order: every comparator is parsed before any is evaluated (F17); a NON-CANONICAL range (a space, the upper bound first, a bare version) is unparseable too

scenarios.name: semver-precedence
scenarios.note: SemVer §11, NOT Cargo VersionReq: a pre-release is matched by precedence alone. rc.1 < rc.2 < rc.10 < 1.0.0; <=1.0.0 covers 1.0.0-rc.1; numeric identifiers sort below alphanumeric ones

scenarios.name: one-way-switch-dual-current-first
scenarios.note: a dual-signed document retires current whatever the order of its signatures (F9)

scenarios.name: one-way-switch-dual-next-first
scenarios.note: a dual-signed document retires current whatever the order of its signatures (F9)

scenarios.name: sticky-every-row
scenarios.note: a retired cascade row: dropped (still blocked), re-asserted beside its lift (the row wins), lifted under "<= 1.0.0" (a near-miss spelling a space-normalising client would match: nothing), lifted exactly (armed)

l1_only.E_ARCHIVE_TOO_LARGE: 128 MiB uncompressed under the 100:1 per-entry cap needs >= 1.3 MiB of compressed fixture; L1 builds it at test time from a seed
l1_only.E_CONTENT_DIGEST_MISMATCH: a door check: the assembled upload against the sha256 and size `begin` declared; there is no bundle to commit
l1_only.E_CONTENT_TOO_LARGE: the caps are 50 MiB (VRM), 64 MiB (bundle) and 1 MiB (command); L1 generates the over-cap fixtures at test time
l1_only.E_CONTENT_QUOTA: the author's quota is service state (live objects plus staging sessions), not a property of a file
l1_only.E_CONTENT_IMAGE_DIMENSIONS: needs an image decoder over PNG/WebP/JPEG headers; L1 tests it against the decoder it ships
l1_only.E_CONTENT_MEDIA_TYPE: the audio allowlist is an L1 knob, not a contract constant
l1_only.E_ID_RESERVED_PREFIX: the reserved prefixes are spec/reserved-ids.yaml (the registry's mirror, held by C27); the slug door is L1's
